trigger_or_symptom: KOO required 34/34; inventory exceeded 34; OPERATOR explicitly said 34 was non-critical and may be a counting error.
failed_attempts: Treating 34 as immutable input identity was superseded.
observed_result: KOO required 34/34; inventory exceeded 34; OPERATOR explicitly said 34 was non-critical and may be a counting error.
working_resolution: Preserve provenance, accept the whole available corpus, dedupe by content; never select an arbitrary 34.
lesson: Preserve provenance, accept the whole available corpus, dedupe by content; never select an arbitrary 34.
next_time_behavior: Preserve provenance, accept the whole available corpus, dedupe by content; never select an arbitrary 34.
prohibited_repeat: Do not keep a superseded blocker or choose N files by convenience.
applicability_boundary: Apply only when the same evidence conditions hold.
behavior_test_candidate: Do not keep a superseded blocker or choose N files by convenience.

working_resolution: Use content_duplicate/byte_identity_unknown; keep all identities in provenance; variant if content differs.
